profile_text.body:
PyTorch Image Models (timm) is an open-source collection of PyTorch image encoders and backbones, founded in 2019 and hosted on GitHub under Hugging Face. The project describes itself as the largest collection of PyTorch image encoders, including training, evaluation, inference, and export scripts alongside pretrained weights. It covers a wide range of architectures including ResNet, ResNeXT, EfficientNet, NFNet, Vision Transformer (ViT), MobileNetV4, RegNet, Swin Transformer, MaxViT, CoAtNet, and ConvNeXt models.

The timm repository actively maintains and adds new model implementations and pretrained weights. Recent additions include Sapiens2 ViTs with EVA and NaFlexViT support, EUPE ViT models from the Efficient Universal Perception Encoder paper, DINOv3 ConvNeXt and ViT models, CSATV2, and EfficientNet-X and EfficientNet-H variants. The project supports various advanced features such as ROPE (Rotary Position Embeddings) across multiple model families, dynamic global pooling options at model creation, and loading models from both the Hugging Face Hub and local directories. All model architecture families include variants with pretrained weights available through the Hugging Face Hub.
